title: Hollis Lounge Chair
tagline: Oak and hand-woven cane, made for afternoons

content.text: Hollis pairs a low oak frame with a back of hand-woven rattan cane. The cane lets light and air through, so the chair feels as good in a sunny corner as it looks.
The wide armrests are made for a cup of coffee or a book left open. Add a linen seat cushion for longer sittings.

care: Dust the cane with a soft brush. Keep out of constant direct sunlight to preserve its colour, and re-oil the frame once a year.
